response.justification: The candidate is a versatile, experienced software engineer but lacks the core requirements for this role: no substantial recent C++ development experience (only brief C/C++ work at National Instruments in 2014-2015), no Windows platform focus (career is Linux/web/cloud oriented), no SQL Server/Oracle depth, and no fixed income, capital markets, or investment banking domain exposure aside from a short unrelated stint at RIDE Capital using Node/TypeScript/GraphQL.
strengths: Strong overall software engineering breadth and seniority (15+ years)
Excellent communication skills demonstrated via talks, workshops, and writing
Experience with CI/CD, testing practices, and diverse tech stacks
concerns: No recent or substantial C++ experience (last significant C/C++ use was ~2014-2015)
No Windows platform development experience evident in work history
No fixed income, derivatives, or capital markets domain expertise; SQL Server/Oracle experience not evidenced

key_factors.factor: No fixed income / capital markets domain expertise
No Windows platform or SQL Server/Oracle experience
